m1NetIssueEditionSnapshot.interpretationZh: 已合并 M1 树上的历史快照。外部所有者签署与合并绑定了该 Head。该布尔值不重开合并。CR-2026-009 接受 664P3-1 作为本 M2 输入版次；664P7 保持已登记且 AFDX 未选。

observationBoundary.eventMappingEn: NETWORK-VISIBLE events are TFTP opcodes on a named file role. LUR is a TFTP write: DL WRQ, TH ACK, DL DATA. APPLICATION payload.decision is a typed ENUM evaluated in the guard before lastDecision is written. PARSE-RESULT/LOCAL events are derived from received files or local analysis and are not additional wire opcodes. ENVIRONMENT timeouts and WAIT-elapsed are enabled only by COMPARE(enablingCompare) of enablingClock and enablingBound.
observationBoundary.eventMappingZh: NETWORK-VISIBLE 事件是具名文件角色上的 TFTP 操作码。LUR 是 TFTP 写：数据加载器 WRQ、目标硬件 ACK、数据加载器 DATA。APPLICATION 的 payload.decision 是有类型枚举，在写入 lastDecision 之前参与守卫求值。PARSE-RESULT/LOCAL 事件由已收文件或本地分析导出，不是额外线上操作码。ENVIRONMENT 超时与 WAIT 到期仅由 enablingClock 与 enablingBound 的 COMPARE(enablingCompare) 使能。
observationBoundary.silenceRuleEn: Absence of a captured packet is not protocol silence unless the observation window, correlation key and clock are declared.
observationBoundary.silenceRuleZh: 未采到报文不是协议静默，除非已声明观测窗口、关联键和时钟。

timeSemantics.delayEn: During delay, clocks in C grow, variables in V are unchanged, and state invariants hold.
timeSemantics.discreteEn: A transition is enabled when its guard holds in the source state. Evaluation order: guard, updates, clock resets, outputs, then target. Outputs are instantaneous on the declared channel.
timeSemantics.raceEn: Timeout events compete with packet events without a forged priority. Simultaneous same-channel events are environment nondeterminism.
timeSemantics.endpointEn: Closed endpoints include equality. Unresolved bounds are not treated as unbounded.
timeSemantics.delayZh: 延时时 C 中时钟增长，V 中变量不变，状态不变量成立。
timeSemantics.discreteZh: 当守卫在源状态成立时迁移使能。求值顺序：守卫、更新、时钟复位、输出，然后进入目标。输出在声明通道上瞬时发生。
timeSemantics.raceZh: 超时事件与报文事件竞争，不伪造优先级。同一通道同时事件视为环境非确定性。
timeSemantics.endpointZh: 闭端点包含相等。未解析边界不视为无界。

scope.compositionEn: One protocol machine with two observation projections (DL, TH) sharing variables and clocks. Not two unsynchronized swimlanes.
scope.compositionZh: 一台协议机器，两个观测投影（DL、TH）共享变量与时钟，不是两张互不同步的泳道。

sourceRefinements.rationaleEn: Successor M1 delta (CR-2026-011) records CRS-M1-00143 as 6.4.4 LUR prose with HEADER-FILE. Shared object HEADER-FILE now supports a candidate 665 edge to CRS-M1-00217. Independent RG1 still required. Capability stays NOT-ESTABLISHED.
sourceRefinements.rationaleZh: 后继 M1 增量（CR-2026-011）将 CRS-M1-00143 记为 6.4.4 的 LUR 散文并含 HEADER-FILE。共享对象 HEADER-FILE 现支持到 CRS-M1-00217 的候选 665 边。仍须独立 RG1。能力保持未建立。

sourceRefinements.rationaleEn: Successor M1 delta records Table 6.4.4-1 FIELD-LOAD-PART-NUMBER-NAME as LUR. Shared object LOAD-PART-NUMBER now supports a candidate 665 edge to CRS-M1-00212. Independent RG1 still required.
sourceRefinements.rationaleZh: 后继 M1 增量将表 6.4.4-1 的 FIELD-LOAD-PART-NUMBER-NAME 记为 LUR。共享对象 LOAD-PART-NUMBER 现支持到 CRS-M1-00212 的候选 665 边。仍须独立 RG1。

sourceRefinements.rationaleEn: Successor M1 delta aligns the LUR write triad with §6.3.2 chart A and the TFTP-write machine: DATA-LOADER WRQ to TARGET-HARDWARE, TARGET-HARDWARE ACK to DATA-LOADER, DATA-LOADER DATA to TARGET-HARDWARE. DLA is the loader application layer, not a network WRQ/ACK endpoint. Independent RG1 still required.
sourceRefinements.rationaleZh: 后继 M1 增量将 LUR 写三元组对齐到 §6.3.2 图 A 与 TFTP 写机器：DATA-LOADER 向 TARGET-HARDWARE 发 WRQ，TARGET-HARDWARE 向 DATA-LOADER 发 ACK，DATA-LOADER 向 TARGET-HARDWARE 发 DATA。DLA 是加载器应用层，不是网络 WRQ/ACK 端点。仍须独立 RG1。

sourceRefinements.rationaleEn: 615A 5.3.2.2 requires transferring TFTP options. RFC 2347 §2 is the option-extension mechanism. The edge uses the public retrieval identity, not a fabricated PDF page. It does not claim complete RFC-2347 conformance.
sourceRefinements.rationaleZh: 615A 5.3.2.2 要求传输 TFTP 选项。RFC 2347 §2 是选项扩展机制。该边使用公共检索身份，不伪造 PDF 页码。不声称完整 RFC-2347 符合性。

sourceRefinements.rationaleEn: 615A 5.3.2.3.8.1 is the Blocksize Option Implementation unit already in M1 (CRS-M1-00034) with DEP-RFC-2348. A token search for 'blksize' cannot negate that source. RFC 2348 §2 is the candidate encoding. Capability stays NOT-ESTABLISHED.
sourceRefinements.rationaleZh: 615A 5.3.2.3.8.1 是 M1 已纳入的 Blocksize Option Implementation 单元（CRS-M1-00034）并带 DEP-RFC-2348。不能用 blksize 词形搜索否定该来源。RFC 2348 §2 是候选编码。能力保持未建立。

sourceRefinements.rationaleEn: UPLOAD/INFORMATION option units do not name RFC 1785 negotiation-option advertisement. P7 listings stay with unselected AFDX.
sourceRefinements.rationaleZh: UPLOAD/INFORMATION 选项单元未点名 RFC 1785 协商选项通告。P7 列举仍随未选择的 AFDX。

sourceRefinements.rationaleEn: 615A exception and DLP timers are protocol parameters, not an identified RFC-2349 timeout/tsize option unit.
sourceRefinements.rationaleZh: 615A 异常与 DLP 定时器是协议参数，不是已识别的 RFC-2349 timeout/tsize 选项单元。

sourceRefinements.rationaleEn: P2 physical identity is recorded. No clause-level model target is delivered in this candidate. This remains an incomplete task, not a bounded trace.
sourceRefinements.rationaleZh: 已记录 P2 物理身份。本候选未交付条款级模型目标。这仍是未完成任务，不是有边界追踪。

sourceRefinements.rationaleEn: P3-1 remains a conditional historical input. Independent RG0 still decides edition acceptance. M1 blocksM1Approval snapshot is not flipped.
sourceRefinements.rationaleZh: P3-1 仍为有条件历史输入。独立 RG0 仍决定版次接受。不翻转 M1 blocksM1Approval 快照。

sourceRefinements.rationaleEn: P7 base edition is recorded for deferred AFDX context only.
sourceRefinements.rationaleZh: P7 初版仅作为延期 AFDX 语境记录。

networkRelationDispositions.rationaleEn: 615A 1.3 invokes P3. DD-023 selects its Compliant Network route; P3 exception tables do not replace applicable RFC behavior. Exact-edition acceptance remains an external review decision.
networkRelationDispositions.rationaleZh: 615A 1.3 引用 P3。DD-023 选择其 Compliant Network 路径；P3 例外表不替代适用 RFC 行为。精确版次接受仍由外部评审决定。

networkRelationDispositions.rationaleEn: The current 615A loader fragmentation/reassembly obligation is retained. DD-023 excludes P3 no-reassembly deviations; MTU is a network-size constraint, not an operation deadline.
networkRelationDispositions.rationaleZh: 保留当前 615A 加载器分片／重组义务。DD-023 排除 P3 不重组偏差；MTU 属于网络尺寸约束，并非操作时限。

networkRelationDispositions.rationaleEn: DL-TFTP refers back to 615A; the AFDX example using port 69 does not override 615A port 59.
networkRelationDispositions.rationaleZh: DL-TFTP 回引 615A；使用端口 69 的 AFDX 示例不覆盖 615A 端口 59。

networkRelationDispositions.rationaleEn: P3 names RFC 2347 for base TFTP options; the precise 615A port-option source unit still needs review before a direct RFC edge is emitted.
networkRelationDispositions.rationaleZh: P3 为基础 TFTP 选项列出 RFC 2347；615A 端口选项的精确来源单元仍需评审，之后才可建立直接 RFC 边。

model.stepSemanticsEn: Delay grows clocks in C; variables stay unchanged; invariants hold. A discrete step binds the input event's typed payload, evaluates the guard (PAYLOAD names read that payload, not implicit variable writes), then updates, then resets matching clock instances, then outputs, then the target. Timeout and WAIT-elapsed events are enabled only by COMPARE(enablingCompare) between enablingClock and enablingBound. The input event is the stimulus; outputs are additional emissions and must not repeat the stimulus as a second message.
model.stepSemanticsZh: 延时时 C 中时钟增长，变量不变，不变量成立。离散步骤先绑定输入事件的有类型 payload，再求值守卫（PAYLOAD 名读取该 payload，不是隐式变量写入），然后更新、复位匹配的时钟实例、输出，进入目标。超时与 WAIT 到期事件仅由 enablingClock 与 enablingBound 之间的 COMPARE(enablingCompare) 使能。输入事件是刺激；输出是额外发射，不得把刺激再计为第二条报文。

infrastructurePremises.behaviorEn: The underlying IPv4/UDP service must satisfy applicable IETF host requirements without P3-specific deviations. Retained as an infrastructure prerequisite; neither implementation compliance nor a complete RFC requirements inventory is claimed. M2 must plan its substantiation before any execution configuration is approved.
infrastructurePremises.behaviorZh: 底层 IPv4/UDP 服务须遵循适用 IETF 主机要求，不采用 P3 特有偏差。此项作为基础设施前提保留；未声称实现符合性或完整 RFC 需求清单。M2 须规划其验证，之后才可批准任何执行配置。
infrastructurePremises.acceptanceEn: Independent review of a Project Configuration that names the host stack and applicable RFC subset.
infrastructurePremises.acceptanceZh: 对指明主机栈与适用 RFC 子集的 Project Configuration 做独立评审。

infrastructurePremises.behaviorEn: Only host requirements actually triggered by the IPv4/UDP path. RFC 1123 does not replace RFC 1122.
infrastructurePremises.behaviorZh: 仅纳入当前 IPv4/UDP 路径真实触发的主机要求。RFC 1123 不替代 RFC 1122。

actions.noteEn: CR-2026-011 executed the successor identities (6.4.4 LUR, 6.4.5 LUS, LUR write endpoints DL WRQ / TH ACK / DL DATA). Independent RG1 still required. This is a bounded M2 baseline, not a development-ready CRS.
actions.noteZh: CR-2026-011 已执行后继身份（6.4.4 为 LUR、6.4.5 为 LUS、LUR 写端点为 DL WRQ／TH ACK／DL DATA）。仍须独立 RG1。这是有界 M2 基线，不是开发就绪 CRS。

actions.noteEn: RFC-2347 option transfer and RFC-2348 block-size are candidate edges; 1785/2349 remain without an active 615A unit.
actions.noteZh: RFC-2347 选项传输与 RFC-2348 块大小为候选边；1785/2349 仍无活动 615A 单元。

actions.noteEn: Attachment 4 equation restored with retry terms; clocks enable timeout transitions.
actions.noteZh: 已恢复带重试项的附件 4 方程；时钟使能超时迁移。
未执行 requirementKind 分类扩展。

actions.noteEn: P2 identity only; no clause-level model target.
actions.noteZh: 仅有 P2 身份；无条款级模型目标。

actions.noteZh: 所有者接受 664P3-1 作为本 M2 输入版次；664P7 保持已登记且 AFDX 未选。
IPv4/UDP 验证计划用于 Configuration。
完整性能力保持未建立。

actions.noteEn: M1 merge facts remain in inputAcceptance.
actions.noteZh: M1 合并事实仍在 inputAcceptance。

actions.noteEn: Successor M1 delta executed under CR-2026-011. Frozen merge bytes stay unchanged as a preserved record. Independent RG1 still required.
actions.noteZh: 后继 M1 增量已在 CR-2026-011 下执行。冻结合并字节作为保留记录不变。仍须独立 RG1。

actions.noteEn: After 6.4.4→LUR there is no dedicated LUI field table. LUI remains a sequence file. Fields are not invented.
actions.noteZh: 6.4.4 改为 LUR 后没有专用 LUI 字段表。LUI 仍是序列文件。不编造字段。

analysisScope.finiteDomainEn: Control states are finite. File payloads are abstracted to named field predicates, length and direction. Symbolic timers remain symbolic. Step semantics are defined; timed reachability is not proved.
analysisScope.finiteDomainZh: 控制状态有限。文件载荷抽象为具名字段谓词、长度和方向。符号定时器保持符号。已定义步语义；未证明定时可达。

discreteWitnesses.summaryEn: UPLOAD init accept: payload.decision=ACCEPT enables the branch; lastDecision is written after the guard.
discreteWitnesses.summaryZh: UPLOAD 初始化接受：payload.decision=ACCEPT 使能该分支；守卫求值后再写入 lastDecision。

discreteWitnesses.summaryEn: UPLOAD init reject from payload.decision=REJECT starting at lastDecision=NONE.
discreteWitnesses.summaryZh: 从 lastDecision=NONE 起，payload.decision=REJECT 使能 UPLOAD 初始化拒绝。

discreteWitnesses.summaryEn: INFORMATION init accept uses the same typed payload, not a pre-written lastDecision.
discreteWitnesses.summaryZh: INFORMATION 初始化接受使用同一有类型 payload，而不是预先写好的 lastDecision。
INFORMATION 初始化拒绝来自 payload.decision=REJECT。

discreteWitnesses.summaryEn: After init accept the list is not yet offered; LUR WRQ is not enabled.
discreteWitnesses.summaryZh: 初始化接受后列表尚未提交；LUR WRQ 不能使能。

discreteWitnesses.summaryEn: After the list is offered but before LUS-0001, LUR WRQ stays disabled.
discreteWitnesses.summaryZh: 列表已提交但尚未收到 LUS-0001 时，LUR WRQ 仍不能使能。

discreteWitnesses.summaryEn: LUS-0001 establishes session-local list readiness; only then DL WRQ LUR, TH ACK and DL DATA are enabled.
discreteWitnesses.summaryZh: LUS-0001 建立会话内列表就绪；此后才使能数据加载器 LUR WRQ、目标硬件 ACK 与数据加载器 DATA。

discreteWitnesses.summaryEn: A later UPLOAD start after INFORMATION completion clears list readiness; offering the list still does not enable LUR WRQ.
discreteWitnesses.summaryZh: INFORMATION 完成后再启动 UPLOAD 时清除列表就绪；提交列表后 LUR WRQ 仍不能使能。

discreteWitnesses.summaryEn: WAIT retry is disabled while CLK_WAIT is below MESSAGE_TIMER_VALUE and enabled at the closed lower bound.
discreteWitnesses.summaryZh: CLK_WAIT 低于 MESSAGE_TIMER_VALUE 时禁止 WAIT 重试；到达闭下界后才使能。

discreteWitnesses.summaryEn: Accept is not enabled by lastDecision alone; missing payload.decision leaves the guard false.
discreteWitnesses.summaryZh: 仅有 lastDecision 不能使能接受；缺少 payload.decision 时守卫为假。

blockingInputs.noteEn: Successor M1 delta executed under CR-2026-011. Frozen merge bytes stay unchanged. Independent RG1 still required.
blockingInputs.noteZh: 后继 M1 增量已在 CR-2026-011 下执行。冻结合并字节不变。仍须独立 RG1。

blockingInputs.noteEn: Successor M1 LUR write endpoints are DATA-LOADER→TARGET-HARDWARE WRQ, TARGET-HARDWARE→DATA-LOADER ACK, DATA-LOADER→TARGET-HARDWARE DATA. Frozen merge bytes stay unchanged.
blockingInputs.noteZh: 后继 M1 的 LUR 写端点为 DATA-LOADER→TARGET-HARDWARE WRQ、TARGET-HARDWARE→DATA-LOADER ACK、DATA-LOADER→TARGET-HARDWARE DATA。冻结合并字节不变。
